# Every market has three competitors: the named vendor, the internal bui…

`sales.mm.market_research.three_competitors` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> Every market has three competitors: the named vendor, the internal build, and doing nothing. Only one of them has a website.
 The two without websites win most evaluations in immature categories and appear in no competitor field, so they are systematically absent from research built on what is easy to find. Naming all three changes the plan, because each is displaced by a different argument.
